resources.string: Displays custom text note directly on your home screen with scrolling and resizing.
Type or paste anything here…\n\nSyllabus, exam schedule, meeting times, to-do list, reminders, quotes, Hindi/English text, emojis, or focus notes.
Tap “+ New note” below to write your first note. You can display any note on your home screen.
Are you sure you want to delete this note? Any home-screen widget displaying it will update to show that the note was removed.

1. Resizing: Long-press the widget on your home screen, then drag the boundary handles to make it as wide or tall as you like (up to full screen).

2. Scrolling: For long notes, simply swipe vertically directly inside the widget.

3. Quick Edit: Tap the small pencil icon in the top-right corner of the widget to immediately edit your note.

4. Multiple Widgets: You can add as many widgets as you like, each showing a different note and customized appearance.
No note selected.\nTap here to configure.
Empty note.\nTap the pencil icon to write content.
This note was deleted.\nTap here to choose another note.
Launcher does not support direct widget pinning. Please add widget from home screen manually.
